_comment: Pinned third-party inputs for bootstrap.ps1 and release.ps1. Change a version here, then update sha256 and run the full release gate.

python_embed._comment: Pinned on first download (python.org does not list this file in windows-<ver>.json).

upstream._comment: Upstream NSIS installer the pinned runtime is minted from. Only scripts/pack-sigrok-cli.ps1 reads it; bootstrap.ps1 never downloads it.

sigrok_cli._comment: Repackaged minimal runtime made by scripts/pack-sigrok-cli.ps1 and uploaded as a GitHub release asset. Empty url means 'not minted yet': bootstrap then stops with instructions - nothing is ever copied from a local machine.

vcredist._comment: Microsoft Visual C++ 2010 x64 runtime (msvcr100.dll, msvcp100.dll). sigrok-cli.exe loads python34.dll, which imports MSVCR100.dll, and the sigrok.org installer does not ship it; pack-sigrok-cli.ps1 copies both DLLs next to sigrok-cli.exe so the runtime also works on machines without the VC++ 2010 redistributable. Only scripts/pack-sigrok-cli.ps1 reads this block.
